caseTitle.en: A long night at the decoction centre

title.en: Night shift at the decoction centre

tagline.zh: 六台煎藥機、一個小鍋、一隻會叫的小雞
tagline.en: Six decoction machines, one small pot, and a chicken that crows

desc.zh: 你開的方，最後是在這裡變成一袋藥。今晚看它怎麼被煎、被封、被送出去，還有怎麼被喝錯。
desc.en: Every formula you write ends up here as a pouch. Tonight you see how it is cooked, sealed and sent out, and how it can still be taken wrongly.

desc.zh: 先煎、後下、包煎、烊化，一機一方。手要穩，鼻子要靈，計時器要信。
desc.en: Decoct first, add late, bag it, melt it in; one machine, one prescription. Steady hands, a good nose, and trust the timer.

role.zh: 中藥局主任、中醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 聞一下煎液就知道少了哪一味。她說那不是天分，是幾十年沒偷懶。
about.en: Can smell which herb is missing from a decoction. She says it is not talent, just decades of not cutting corners.

about.zh: 個子很大，動作很輕。有一個小雞造型的計時器，他相信它勝過煎藥機的螢幕。
about.en: Very large, very gentle hands. Owns a chicken-shaped kitchen timer that he trusts more than the machine's display.

about.zh: 管層析儀和留樣冰箱。她的字典裡沒有「差不多」這三個字。
about.en: Runs the chromatograph and the retained-sample fridge. The phrase “close enough” is not in her dictionary.

role.en: Fifty-four, on chemotherapy for breast cancer

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。國中國文老師，化療第三個療程。戴著學生織的毛帽，說最怕的不是掉頭髮，是吃不下。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Junior-high Chinese teacher, third cycle of chemotherapy. Wears a beanie her students knitted; says the worst part is not the hair but not being able to eat.

about.zh: 提著一個寫著「老婆的藥」的保冷袋。什麼都想幫忙，常常幫過頭。
about.en: Carries a cool bag labelled “my wife's medicine”. Wants to help with everything and often overdoes it.

about.zh: 回答問題前會先把病人的肚子再摸一次。
about.en: Feels the patient's abdomen once more before answering any question.

plain.zh: 醫院或藥局依處方替病人把藥煎好、分裝成一袋袋密封，病人帶回家冷藏，喝前加熱。
plain.en: The hospital or pharmacy cooks the prescription, divides it into sealed pouches, and the patient refrigerates them at home and warms one before drinking.

plain.zh: 礦物、貝殼類質地堅硬，或附子這類要久煮減毒的，先下鍋煮一段時間，再放其他藥。
plain.en: Hard minerals and shells, or aconite that needs long cooking to lose toxicity, go into the pot alone first; the other herbs follow later.

plain.zh: 薄荷、砂仁這類含揮發油，或大黃這類久煮會失去瀉下力的，在煎煮快結束時才放。
plain.en: Herbs with volatile oils like mint and amomum, or rhubarb whose purgative power cooks away, go in near the end.

plain.zh: 細小種子、粉末或有絨毛的藥，如車前子、滑石、旋覆花，裝進紗布袋再煎，免得糊鍋、混濁或刺激喉嚨。
plain.en: Tiny seeds, powders or hairy herbs, such as plantain seed, talc or inula flower, go into a muslin bag so they do not scorch, cloud the liquid or scratch the throat.

plain.zh: 人參這類貴重藥單獨小鍋煎，再兌入藥汁，不讓群藥的藥渣吸走。
plain.en: Precious herbs like ginseng are cooked alone in a small pot and added to the liquid afterwards, so the other dregs do not soak them up.

plain.zh: 阿膠這類膠類藥不和群藥同煎，放進煎好的熱藥汁裡溶化。同煎會黏鍋、黏藥渣。
plain.en: Gelatins like ejiao are not boiled with the rest but melted into the hot finished liquid. Boiled together they stick to the pot and the dregs.

plain.zh: 三七粉、芒硝這類不入鍋，用煎好的藥汁或溫開水調開直接服。
plain.en: Things like notoginseng powder or mirabilite never go in the pot; they are stirred into the finished decoction or warm water and drunk.

plain.zh: 處方中沒有特殊煎法的其他藥材，一起下鍋煎。
plain.en: All the herbs in a prescription without special handling, cooked together.

plain.zh: 加壓、密閉、自動的煎藥機，省時又衛生。但煮到一半不能開蓋加藥，後下的藥要另外處理。
plain.en: A pressurised, sealed, automatic cooker; fast and clean. But it cannot be opened mid-cook, so add-late herbs need separate handling.

plain.zh: 承氣湯類原文的提醒：排便了，後面的藥就停，不要喝完。
plain.en: The classical instruction for the Chengqi purgatives: once the bowels move, stop the remaining doses; do not finish the course.

plain.zh: 中醫認為燥熱和糟粕結在腸裡：多日不便、肚子脹硬、苔黃而乾。大承氣湯的對證。
plain.en: In TCM reasoning, dry heat bound up with waste in the intestines: days without a stool, a hard swollen belly, a dry yellow coat. The pattern Da Chengqi Tang treats.

plain.zh: 用層析儀測的代表性化學成分。用來確認藥材真偽、煎法對不對、每一批是不是一樣。
plain.en: A representative chemical measured by chromatography, used to confirm identity, check the cooking method, and compare batches.

plain.zh: 藥袋鼓起來，代表裡面有微生物在產氣。藥已經壞了，不能喝。
plain.en: A pouch that has puffed up means microbes inside are making gas. The decoction has spoiled; do not drink it.

plain.zh: 每一批煎好的藥留一份封存冷藏。出事時可以回頭檢驗，證明是不是藥的問題。
plain.en: One pouch of every batch is sealed and kept cold, so that if something goes wrong it can be tested to see whether the medicine was at fault.

plain.zh: 化療後白血球可能很低，這時發燒可能是快速惡化的感染。必須立刻到急診，不能等。
plain.en: After chemotherapy the white cell count may be very low, and a fever can be a fast-moving infection. It means the emergency department at once, no waiting.

text.zh: 六台煎藥機，每一台上面貼的不是機號，是一個病人的名字和病歷號。一機一方，一方一單。
text.en: Six machines; each carries not a number but a patient's name and chart number. One machine, one prescription, one order slip.

text.zh: 附子先煎、大黃小鍋都在這下面。蒸氣不聞、不嘗，阿熊說這是代煎中心的第一條規矩。
text.en: Aconite pre-cooks and the small rhubarb pot both happen under here. No sniffing, no tasting the steam: Bear's first rule of the centre.

text.zh: 把煎液拆成一根根峰。後下和久煎的大黃，在螢幕上是兩張不一樣的圖。
text.en: Splits a decoction into a row of peaks. Rhubarb added late and rhubarb boiled long are two different pictures on the screen.

name.en: The retained pouch from Mrs Chien's batch

text.zh: 封口完整，沒有鼓。小葳在上面貼了一張黃色便條：「這袋是好的。問題在路上。」
text.en: Seal intact, not swollen. Wei sticks a yellow note on it: “This one is fine. The problem was on the way home.”

text.zh: 塑膠小雞，轉一圈會「咕咕」叫。阿熊說：「機器會當機，小雞不會。」下班時他把它放在你手上。
text.en: A plastic chicken that clucks when the dial runs out. “Machines crash,” says Bear. “The chicken doesn't.” At the end of the night he puts it in your hand.

text.zh: 先煎：硬的要煮透，附子要減毒。後下：揮發油會跑、大黃的瀉下成分怕久煮。包煎：細粉絨毛會糊鍋刺喉。另煎：貴重藥不給藥渣吸走。烊化：膠會黏鍋。沖服：粉末和鹽類不必煎。每一種都是為了讓該出來的出來、該留下的留下，不是儀式。
text.en: Decoct first: hard things need cooking through, aconite needs detoxifying. Add late: volatile oils escape and rhubarb's purgative compounds break down with long boiling. Bag it: fine powders and hairs scorch and scratch. Cook separately: keep precious herbs from the dregs. Melt in: gelatin sticks. Stir in: powders and salts need no boiling. Each one gets out what should come out and keeps what should stay. None of it is ritual.

name.en: Three questions before a Chengqi formula

text.zh: 峻下劑之前先問：有沒有排氣？有沒有嘔吐？肚子是脹軟，還是脹硬、壓痛、越來越大？排氣停止、嘔吐、腹痛加劇、肚子越來越脹，可能是腸阻塞，要請醫師檢查、照影像、會診外科，不是再瀉一次。用了之後：得下止服；孕婦、年老體弱慎用。
text.en: Before a drastic purgative ask: is wind passing? Any vomiting? Is the belly soft and bloated, or hard, tender and growing? No wind, vomiting, worsening pain or a swelling belly may be bowel obstruction: a doctor's examination, imaging and a surgical opinion, never another purge. After it is given: stop once it works; caution in pregnancy, old age and frailty.

name.en: The life of a decoction pouch

text.zh: 代煎藥液沒有防腐劑。封口後冷藏，按標示期限喝完；喝前倒進杯子或隔水溫熱，不整袋微波。袋子鼓起、有酸味或氣泡，就丟。化療、洗腎、免疫抑制的病人尤其不能冒險。衛教要問到最後一句：「你回家放在哪裡？」
text.en: Decoctions carry no preservative. Sealed, refrigerated, used within the labelled period; warmed in a cup or a water bath, never microwaved in the sealed pouch. Swollen, sour-smelling or fizzing: throw it away. Patients on chemotherapy, dialysis or immunosuppressants least of all can take the risk. Counselling ends with one question: “Where will you keep it at home?”

name.en: Two identifiers, one machine per prescription

text.zh: 收方、上機、包裝、出貨，每一關都用兩種識別：姓名加病歷號，再掃條碼對機號。一台機器一次只煎一個人的方，煎完清洗再換下一張，避免交叉污染與拿錯。每一批留樣，出事時才查得到。
text.en: At order, loading, packing and dispatch, two identifiers every time: name plus chart number, then a barcode scan against the machine. One machine cooks one patient's prescription at a time and is cleaned before the next, to prevent mix-ups and cross-contamination. Every batch keeps a retained sample so problems can be traced.

note.en: Six steps of the service; one machine, one prescription

guide.en: Find Teacher Chiu at the workstation

lines.zh: 代煎中心下午三點。六台密閉式煎藥機排成一列，第一台上面站著一隻塑膠小雞。
lines.en: The decoction centre at three in the afternoon. Six sealed decoction machines in a row; on the first one stands a plastic chicken.

lines.zh: 今晚你跟代煎。我們把藥煎好、分袋、封口、冷藏，病人回家只要加熱。
lines.en: Tonight you're on the decoction service. We cook, divide, seal and chill; at home the patient only warms it.

lines.zh: 問你：代煎最怕的三件事？
lines.en: Question: the three things a decoction service fears most?

lines.zh: 拿錯人、煎錯法……第三個？
lines.en: Wrong patient, wrong method… and the third?

lines.zh: 壞在袋子裡。前兩個是我們的手，第三個是時間和溫度。
lines.en: Spoiling in the pouch. The first two are our hands; the third is time and temperature.

q.zh: 代煎從收方到出貨的順序
q.en: The decoction service from order to dispatch

post.zh: 一機一方，一方一單。機器上貼的不是編號，是一個人的名字和病歷號。
post.en: One machine, one prescription, one slip. What's taped on each machine is not a number; it's a person's name and chart number.

post.zh: 還有第三步。今晚三張單裡，每一張都有不一樣的「特殊」。
post.en: And step three. Each of tonight's three orders has a different “special”.

note.zh: 先煎、後下、包煎、另煎、烊化、沖服
note.en: First, late, bagged, separate, melted, stirred in

guide.en: Find Bear at the decoction line

lines.zh: 一號鍋有龍骨牡蠣，二號鍋有薄荷砂仁，三號鍋有阿膠。同樣叫「煎藥」，做法完全不同。
lines.en: Pot one has dragon bone and oyster shell, pot two mint and amomum, pot three ejiao. All called “decocting”; all done differently.

lines.zh: 先考你：盤子裡哪些要先煎？
lines.en: First test: which of these on the tray get decocted first?

q.en: Select the herbs that must be decocted first

post.zh: 礦物貝殼硬，先煮才煮得透；附子先煎久煎是減毒。抽氣罩打開，那個蒸氣不要聞。
post.en: Minerals and shells are hard and need cooking through; aconite goes first and long to lose its toxicity. Fume hood on, and don't breathe that steam.

post.zh: 那剩下幾味呢？薄荷、砂仁、阿膠、三七。
post.en: And the rest? Mint, amomum, ejiao, notoginseng.

post.zh: 薄荷砂仁後下，揮發油怕久煮。阿膠烊化，三七粉沖服。
post.en: Mint and amomum are added late; volatile oils fear a long boil. Ejiao is melted in; notoginseng powder is stirred in and drunk.

post.zh: 還有兩個：車前子要包煎，裝紗布袋；人參要另煎，自己一個小鍋。
post.en: Two more: plantain seed is cooked in a bag of muslin; ginseng is cooked separately in its own small pot.

lines.zh: 二號鍋，你來。先煎的先下，群藥跟上，後下的最後。小雞會叫。
lines.en: Pot two is yours. Decoct-first herbs in first, the main herbs next, add-late herbs last. The chicken will crow.

lines.zh: 可是密閉式煎藥機中途不能開蓋……
lines.en: But a sealed decoction machine can't be opened mid-cook…

lines.zh: 對，所以後下的放旁邊小鍋，最後兌在一起。你先把順序做對。
lines.en: Right, so the add-late herbs go in the small pot beside it and get combined at the end. Get the order right first.

post.zh: 小雞計時器咕咕叫了。阿熊對它點頭，像在跟同事打招呼。
post.en: The chicken timer clucks. Bear nods at it, the way you would greet a colleague.

post.zh: 機器會當機，小雞不會。
post.en: Machines crash. The chicken doesn't.

guide.en: Watch the ejiao for pot three

lines.zh: 三號鍋的阿膠，昨天實習生直接丟進機器裡。你猜發生什麼事？
lines.en: Yesterday a student threw pot three's ejiao straight into the machine. Guess what happened.

q.zh: 阿膠為什麼要烊化，不和群藥同煎？
q.en: Why is ejiao melted in rather than boiled with the main herbs?

options.zh: 同煎會黏鍋、黏藥渣，藥損失
options.en: It sticks to pot and dregs and is lost

why.zh: 膠類加熱後很黏，會糊在鍋底、包住藥渣，濾掉時一起丟掉，還可能燒焦。放進煎好的熱藥汁裡攪到溶化就好。
why.en: Heated gelatin turns very sticky, coats the pot and wraps the dregs, gets strained away with them and may scorch. Stir it into the finished hot liquid until it dissolves.

options.en: Ejiao is toxic and kept apart

why.zh: 阿膠不是毒劇藥。分開處理是因為物理性質，不是毒性。
why.en: Ejiao is not a toxic herb. It is handled apart because of how it behaves physically, not because of toxicity.

why.zh: 昨天那台機器洗了很久。這不是習慣，是黏。
why.en: Yesterday's machine took a long time to clean. It is not habit; it is glue.

post.zh: 那台機器我洗到晚上八點。小雞都叫了三次。
post.en: I was scrubbing that machine till eight. The chicken crowed three times.

note.zh: 承氣湯前三問；大黃要後下
note.en: Three questions before Chengqi; rhubarb goes late

sub.zh: 梁伯的大承氣湯，可以今晚先煎嗎
sub.en: Mr Liang's Da Chengqi Tang tonight?

lines.zh: 代煎中心嗎？梁伯，六十四歲，腰椎手術後在用止痛藥，五天沒解便。主治開了大承氣湯。
lines.en: Decoction centre? Mr Liang, sixty-four, after spinal surgery and on painkillers, no stool for five days. His attending has prescribed Da Chengqi Tang.

lines.zh: 煎之前先問三件事：有沒有排氣？有沒有吐？肚子是脹軟，還是脹硬、壓痛？
lines.en: Three questions before we cook: is he passing wind? Vomiting? Is the belly soft and bloated, or hard and tender?

lines.zh: 有排氣，沒吐。脹但軟，主治下午摸過、照過片子，說是糞便多。舌苔黃、很乾。
lines.en: Passing wind, no vomiting. Bloated but soft; the attending examined him and saw the film this afternoon: mostly stool. Tongue coat yellow and very dry.

lines.zh: 好，腑實，三題都過。這時候才輪到我們煎。
lines.en: Good: bowel excess, and all three answers pass. Only now is it our turn to cook.

lines.zh: 承氣湯是一家人：大承氣、小承氣、調胃承氣，隔壁還住著麻子仁丸。先挑大的。
lines.en: The Chengqi formulas are a family: major, minor, stomach-regulating, and Maziren Wan lives next door. Pick the major one.

q.zh: 挑出大承氣湯的四味藥
q.en: Select the four herbs of Da Chengqi Tang

post.zh: 去芒硝是小承氣；去枳實厚朴、加甘草是調胃承氣。火麻仁、杏仁、白芍那邊，是潤腸的麻子仁丸。
post.en: Drop the mirabilite and it's the minor one; drop bitter orange and magnolia bark, add liquorice, and it's the stomach-regulating one. Hemp seed, apricot kernel and white peony belong to the gentler Maziren Wan.

post.zh: 大承氣湯是峻下。原文寫「得下止服」，我們的標籤上也要寫。
post.en: Da Chengqi Tang is a drastic purge. The text says “stop once it works”, and so must our label.

guide.en: How to cook the rhubarb and mirabilite

lines.zh: 問題來了。機器一關蓋就煮到底。大黃要後下，芒硝要沖服。你說怎麼辦？
lines.en: Here's the problem. Once the lid's down the machine runs to the end. Rhubarb goes late, mirabilite gets stirred in. What do we do?

q.zh: 大承氣湯用密閉式煎藥機代煎。大黃後下、芒硝沖服怎麼處理？
q.en: Da Chengqi Tang in a sealed machine. How do you handle late rhubarb and stirred-in mirabilite?

options.zh: 群藥機煎，大黃小鍋後下，芒硝分包
options.en: Machine for the rest; rhubarb late in a pot

why.zh: 機器不能中途開蓋，就把大黃放進小鍋，在最後短煮再兌入；芒硝不煎，分包標示「沖服」，服前溶進藥汁。
why.en: The machine cannot be opened mid-cook, so the rhubarb goes in a small pot for a short boil at the end and is combined; the mirabilite is not boiled but packed separately, labelled to be dissolved in the decoction before drinking.

options.zh: 全部放進機器一起煎，省時

why.zh: 大黃久煎，瀉下有關的成分會被破壞，藥變成清熱有餘、通便不足。
why.en: Boiled long, rhubarb's purgative compounds break down; the formula clears heat but barely moves the bowels.

options.zh: 大黃先煎，煮久比較有效

why.zh: 方向相反。要大黃清熱活血、不要它瀉的時候才久煎；要通便，就後下。
why.en: The wrong way round. Rhubarb is cooked long only when you want its heat-clearing, not its purging; to move the bowels, it goes in late.

note.zh: 脾氣虛；內關；冷藏與發燒就急診
note.en: Spleen qi deficiency; PC6; refrigerate, and fever means emergency

guide.en: Meet Mrs Chien at the door

lines.zh: 門口來了一對夫妻。簡太太戴著毛帽，簡先生提著保冷袋，袋子上寫「老婆的藥」。
lines.en: A couple at the door. Mrs Chien in a knitted beanie; Mr Chien holding a cool bag labelled “my wife's medicine”.

lines.zh: 腫瘤科的中醫師開的，說可以顧胃。化療完一直想吐，什麼都吃不下。
lines.en: The TCM doctor in oncology prescribed it, for my stomach. Since the chemo I keep feeling sick and can't eat a thing.

lines.zh: 她瘦好多。我想在家燉人參雞給她補，可以嗎？
lines.en: She's lost so much weight. Can I make her ginseng chicken soup at home?

lines.zh: 先別急著加。化療期間任何補品，都先問腫瘤科和開方的中醫師。我們先看舌。
lines.en: Hold off on adding things. Any tonic during chemo, ask oncology and the prescribing TCM doctor first. Let's look at the tongue.

q.zh: 簡太太的舌：淡，邊有齒痕，苔薄白。噁心、食慾差、倦怠。證型？
q.en: Mrs Chien's tongue: pale, tooth-marked edges, thin white coat. Nausea, poor appetite, fatigue. The pattern?

why.zh: 舌淡有齒痕是脾氣虛、運化無力；食慾差、倦怠、噁心，中醫認為是化療傷了脾胃。香砂六君子湯健脾和胃、行氣止嘔，方向對。
why.en: A pale, tooth-marked tongue means weak spleen qi that cannot transform; poor appetite, fatigue and nausea are, in TCM reasoning, chemotherapy having injured the spleen and stomach. Xiangsha Liujunzi Tang strengthens them and settles the nausea: the right direction.

why.zh: 胃陰虛舌紅少苔、口乾。她的舌是淡的，苔還在。
why.en: Stomach yin deficiency gives a red tongue with little coat and a dry mouth. Hers is pale and the coat is there.

why.zh: 鬱熱舌紅苔黃、口苦泛酸。和淡舌白苔不合。
why.en: Stagnant heat gives a red tongue, a yellow coat, a bitter taste and acid. Not a pale tongue with white coat.

why.zh: 血瘀舌紫暗或有瘀斑。她的舌沒有紫。
why.en: Stasis gives a dark purple or spotted tongue. Hers has no purple.

post.zh: 脾氣虛。方裡的砂仁、木香，阿熊已經另外小鍋後下了。
post.en: Spleen qi deficiency. Bear has already cooked the amomum and aucklandia late, in a small pot.

guide.en: Teach Mr Chien to press Neiguan

lines.zh: 想吐的時候，有沒有可以自己按的地方？
lines.en: When the nausea comes, is there somewhere I can press?

lines.zh: 內關。點給她看，也教簡先生。他的手比較有空。
lines.en: Neiguan. Show her, and teach Mr Chien too. His hands are freer.

post.zh: 手腕內側橫紋往上約三橫指，兩條筋中間。按到痠脹，慢慢揉。
post.en: Inner wrist, about three finger-widths up from the crease, between the two tendons. Press till it aches a little; rub slowly.

post.zh: 這個我可以。她想吐，我就按。
post.en: This I can do. When she feels sick, I press.

post.zh: 按穴是幫忙，不取代腫瘤科的止吐藥。兩個一起用。
post.en: Pressing helps; it doesn't replace oncology's anti-sickness medicine. Use both.

guide.zh: 回答簡先生的保存問題

lines.zh: 一次拿七袋，家裡冰箱塞滿了，放室溫可以嗎？她常常一袋只喝一半。
lines.en: Seven pouches at once and our fridge is full. Can they stay at room temperature? She often only drinks half.

q.zh: 代煎藥袋怎麼保存與加熱？
q.en: How should decoction pouches be stored and warmed?

options.zh: 冷藏，喝前倒杯隔水溫熱
options.en: Refrigerate; warm a cupful in water

why.zh: 代煎藥液沒有防腐劑，室溫會長菌。化療中免疫力低，更不能冒險。喝不完的半袋不留到下一餐；脹袋、有酸味就丟。
why.en: Decoctions have no preservative and grow bacteria at room temperature. On chemotherapy her defences are low; no risks. A half-drunk pouch is not kept for the next meal; a swollen pouch or a sour smell goes in the bin.

options.en: A week at room temperature is fine

why.zh: 室溫一週，袋子多半會鼓起來。那就是脹袋，裡面在長東西。
why.en: A week at room temperature and most pouches will puff up. That swelling is something growing inside.

why.zh: 密封袋整袋微波可能爆開燙傷，也加熱不均。倒進杯子再熱。
why.en: A sealed pouch can burst and scald, and heats unevenly. Pour it into a cup first.

post.zh: 還有一件比藥更重要的事：化療期間只要發燒，不管幾點，直接去急診。不要等喝完中藥看看。
post.en: And one thing more important than the medicine: any fever during chemotherapy, any hour, straight to emergency. Don't wait to see if the herbs help.

post.zh: 發燒就急診。我記住了。
post.en: Fever means emergency. Got it.

note.zh: 後下的差別看得見；出貨前五道核對
note.en: Late addition shows on screen; checks before dispatch

guide.en: Go to the chromatography bay with Wei

lines.zh: 品管時間。同一批大黃，一鍋後下、一鍋跟群藥久煎，看指標成分差多少。儀器在哪你知道嗎？
lines.en: QC time. One batch of rhubarb, one pot added late, one boiled long with the main herbs; we see how far the marker compounds differ. You know where the instrument is?

post.zh: 圖出來了。後下那鍋，瀉下有關的成分峰比較高；久煎那鍋，掉了一大截。
post.en: Here's the trace. In the late pot, the purgative-related peaks stand tall; in the long-boiled pot, they've dropped a long way.

post.zh: 這就是後下的道理。不是古人的習慣，是儀器看得到的差別。
post.en: That's why we add late. Not an ancient habit; a difference an instrument can see.

post.zh: 我不說差不多。我說掉了一截。
post.en: I don't say “close enough”. I say “dropped a long way”.

lines.zh: 今晚的袋子要出貨了。封口、標示、留樣、裝箱，一步都不能跳。
lines.en: Tonight's pouches are going out. Seal, label, retain, box; not one step skipped.

q.zh: 代煎藥袋出貨前的核對順序
q.en: Order of checks before decoction pouches leave

steps.en: Scan the order barcode; match machine

steps.zh: 核對方名、袋數、服法標示
留樣封存，貼冷藏標示裝箱
steps.en: Retain a sample; cold label; box

post.zh: 每一批都留一袋。我們希望永遠用不到。
post.en: One pouch from every batch stays here. We hope we never need it.

post.zh: 梁伯的藥袋上，粗體多了一行：「得下止服。排便後請先暫停，通知醫師。」芒硝另一小包，寫著「沖服」。
post.en: Mr Liang's pouch gains a bold line: “Stop once it works. Pause after a bowel movement and tell the doctor.” The mirabilite has its own sachet, marked “stir in”.

note.zh: 得下止服；脹吐不排氣是紅旗
note.en: Stop once it works; bloating, vomiting, no wind are red flags

sub.zh: 梁伯解了，下一包要給嗎
sub.en: Mr Liang has gone; give the next pouch?

lines.zh: 梁伯解了一次，量很多，肚子軟了。下一包還要給嗎？
lines.en: Mr Liang has opened his bowels, a lot, and his belly's soft. Do we give the next pouch?

lines.zh: 先不要給。大承氣湯是得下止服。我請主治確認後面怎麼調。
lines.en: Not yet. Da Chengqi Tang stops once it works. I'll ask the attending how to continue.

lines.zh: 好，先暫停。梁伯問代煎中心是不是有魔法。
lines.en: OK, on hold. Mr Liang asks whether the decoction centre does magic.

lines.zh: 沒有魔法，只有一個小鍋。
lines.en: No magic. Just a small pot.

sub.zh: 梁伯沒解，更脹了，還吐了一次
sub.en: Mr Liang: nothing yet, more bloated, vomited once

lines.zh: 梁伯喝了還沒解。肚子比剛剛更脹，吐了一次，排氣也變少了。要再給一包嗎？
lines.en: Mr Liang's taken it and nothing's happened. His belly is more swollen, he's vomited once, and less wind. Shall we give another pouch?

lines.zh: 停，不要再給。脹、吐、排氣減少，可能是腸阻塞的紅旗。請主治馬上看，必要時照片子、會診外科。
lines.en: Stop. No more. Bloating, vomiting and less wind can be the red flags of bowel obstruction. Ask the attending to see him now, with imaging and a surgical opinion if needed.

lines.zh: 會不會是大黃煮太久，藥力不夠……
lines.en: Could it be the rhubarb was boiled too long and lost its strength…

lines.zh: 有可能，晚點品管會查。但現在的問題是病人，不是藥。紅旗先轉，不是再加一包。
lines.en: Possibly; QC will check. But right now the problem is the patient, not the formula. Red flags get referred, not purged again.

lines.zh: 一小時後護理師回電：主治看過，片子沒有阻塞，是脹氣加止痛藥。處理後解了。品管確認那一鍋的大黃指標成分偏低。
lines.en: An hour later the nurse calls back: the attending examined him and the film shows no obstruction, just gas and painkillers. Treated, he has opened his bowels. QC confirms that pot's rhubarb markers were low.

note.zh: 化療中發燒：先急診，藥袋我們查
note.en: Fever on chemo: emergency first; we trace the pouch

sub.zh: 她發燒發抖，那袋藥鼓鼓的
sub.en: She's feverish and shaking; that pouch was puffy

lines.zh: 她剛剛喝了一袋，那袋好像鼓鼓的、有點酸。現在一直發抖，燒到三十八度多。
lines.en: She just drank a pouch; it looked a bit puffy and smelled sour. Now she's shivering and the thermometer says over thirty-eight.

lines.zh: 簡先生，先不管那袋藥。
lines.en: Mr Chien, forget the pouch for a moment.

options.zh: 化療中發燒，立刻去急診

why.zh: 化療後白血球可能很低，發燒可能是嚴重感染，要立刻抽血、評估、用抗生素。帶著化療紀錄。藥袋的問題我們來查，人先走。
why.en: After chemotherapy her white cells may be very low and a fever can be a serious infection needing blood tests, assessment and antibiotics at once. Bring the chemo records. We'll trace the pouch; she goes now.

why.zh: 化療中發燒不能等天亮。感染在白血球低的時候進展很快。
why.en: Fever during chemotherapy cannot wait for morning. Infection moves fast when white cells are low.

options.zh: 吃退燒藥，退了就不用去
options.en: Paracetamol; if it drops, stay home

why.zh: 退燒藥會把警訊蓋掉，感染還在。先急診，退燒怎麼用由急診決定。
why.en: An antipyretic hides the warning sign; the infection is still there. Emergency first; they decide about fever medicine.

post.zh: 好，現在出門。那袋藥要帶嗎？
post.en: Right, we're leaving now. Bring the pouch?

post.zh: 帶著，連同空袋子。剩下的先不要喝，冰起來，明天拿回來給我們。
post.en: Yes, and the empty one. Don't drink the rest; keep them chilled and bring them back tomorrow.

guide.en: Check the retained sample with Wei

lines.zh: 簡太太那批的留樣我拿出來了。封口完整、沒有鼓。培養要明天才知道。
lines.en: I've pulled the retained sample from Mrs Chien's batch. Seal intact, not swollen. The culture will take till tomorrow.

lines.zh: 簡先生早上說冰箱滿了。那七袋，下午放在哪裡？
lines.en: Mr Chien said his fridge was full. Where were those seven pouches this afternoon?

lines.zh: ……我跟他講了冷藏，但沒問他回家放在哪。
lines.en: …I told him to refrigerate, but I didn't ask where he'd actually keep them.

lines.zh: 發燒的原因要醫院查，多半跟白血球有關，不一定是那袋藥。但脹袋喝下去，是我們衛教的洞。明天打電話，問到最後一句。
lines.en: The hospital will find the cause of the fever; most likely her white cells, not necessarily the pouch. But a swollen pouch being drunk is a hole in our counselling. Tomorrow we phone, and ask right to the last question.

note.zh: 洗機防交叉污染；小雞換手
note.en: Clean against cross-contamination; the chicken changes hands

lines.zh: 每一鍋之間都要洗。上一鍋的附子不能留到下一個人的藥裡，過敏的人也一樣。
lines.en: Every pot is cleaned between patients. The last pot's aconite must not end up in the next person's medicine; same for anyone with an allergy.

lines.zh: 一機一方，煎完就洗。
lines.en: One machine, one prescription, cleaned after each.

lines.zh: 還有濾網。藥渣卡在濾網裡，明天就是別人的味道。
lines.en: And the strainers. Dregs stuck in a strainer become somebody else's flavour tomorrow.

sub.zh: 急診說白血球很低，住院了
sub.en: Emergency says her white count is low; admitted

lines.zh: 急診說白血球很低，住院打抗生素，人穩定了。醫生說來得很快。冰箱我清出一層了。
lines.en: Emergency says her white count is very low; she's admitted on antibiotics and stable. The doctor said we came quickly. I've cleared a shelf in the fridge.

lines.zh: 你那一句「發燒就急診」，今晚比藥有用。
lines.en: Your one line, “fever means emergency”, did more tonight than any medicine.

lines.zh: 這個給你。我抽屜裡還有一隻。
lines.en: This is for you. I've got another in my drawer.

lines.zh: 小雞……你不是說它比機器可靠？
lines.en: The chicken… didn't you say it's more reliable than the machine?

lines.zh: 所以才給你。你開方的時候會想到它：每一味都有它該下鍋的時間。
lines.en: That's why. When you prescribe, you'll think of it: every herb has its moment to go in the pot.

lines.zh: 代煎中心的燈一盞盞關掉。抽氣罩停了，最後一個聲音是口袋裡的小雞，輕輕咕了一聲。
lines.en: The centre's lights go off one by one. The fume hood falls silent; the last sound is the chicken in your pocket, giving one soft cluck.

sub.zh: 一個小鍋、一句「發燒就急診」、一隻小雞
sub.en: One small pot, one line about fever, one chicken
